title: Starbucks debuts 5 new Bearista cups for the holiday season
text:
Starbucks debuts 5 new Bearista cups for the holiday season - ABC7 Los Angeles 
 24/7 Live Los Angeles Orange County Inland Empire Ventura County California Starbucks 
 Starbucks debuts 5 new Bearista cups for the holiday season 
 The global coffee chain first introduced Bearista cups in December 2025. 
 The global coffee chain first introduced Bearista cups in December 2025, and the cups quickly sold out. WPVI By Yi-Jin Yu Tuesday, November 10, 2026 11:31AM Share Follow ABC7 on Google Starbucks is introducing not one, but five new Bearista cups this holiday season.
 The new limited-edition hand-blown glass cups, which make their official debut this week, include Aspen, a skiing bear; Reiny, a reindeer bear; Bunny, a snow bunny bear; Joy, an ice skating bear; and a mystery bear named Goldie.
 The new limited-edition hand-blown glass cups include Aspen, a skiing bear; Reiny, a reindeer bear; Bunny, a snow bunny bear; Joy, an ice skating bear Starbucks Each of the new Bearista cups will also include a card that shares "their vibe, holiday tradition and signature Starbucks beverage order," the coffee giant said in a press release.
 The winter-themed Bearista cups will cost $39.95 each, while supplies last, and are limited to two purchases per customer.

 The cups will be available at select Starbucks locations starting Nov. 10, but Starbucks Rewards Reserve members get early access to the special Bearista cups -- with a limit of one cup per customer -- starting Nov. 9 at 1 p.m. ET on the Starbucks Shop.
 Starbucks' Bearista cups have proven extremely popular among customers and collectors and sold out quickly after their initial launch in November 2025.
 Since then, the global coffee chain has also introduced a Snoopy glass cup , a Pink Bearista cup with a strawberry straw topper, and a Soccer Bearista cup, alongside the original glass cup.
